title: Marryandbride footer
description: A boutique footer under a giant light serif wordmark that spans the whole width. Below it: a short about text at the left, two link columns with serif headings and tracked uppercase links at the right, a row of accepted payment methods, a hairline, and a last row of tiny uppercase legal links, social links and the copyright. On phones everything stacks and the last rows centre.
notes: the wordmark's size is set in vw for a word of about nine letters; a much longer or shorter one needs the size class changed
payment methods are plain text labels (no third-party logos)
